legend.en: Sometimes even the most enthusiastic Orks need a little ‘encouragement’ to stay in the fight.

when.en: Any phase, when a friendly attached ORKS INFANTRY unit becomes battle-shocked.

target.en: That ORKS INFANTRY unit. You can target that unit with this stratagem even though it is battle-shocked.

effect.en: Roll one D3: Your unit suffers a number of mortal wounds equal to the result. Your unit is no longer battle-shocked.

legend.en: Even the weediest Orks possess great strength, and need little persuasion to bring it to bear.

when.en: Fight phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to fight.

effect.en: Your unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits].

legend.en: So resilient is Ork physiology - and so slow are Orks on the uptake - even death can take time to register.

when.en: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ORKS unit (excluding TITANIC units).

effect.en: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if your unit is riled up: On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

legend.en: Spiked rams, deff rollas and glyph-heavy dozer blades are more than just stylish statements for the crew of Ork vehicles.

when.en: Fight phase, when a friendly ORKS VEHICLE unit (excluding WALKER units) that made a charge move this turn is selected to fight.

effect.en: Your unit’s melee attacks have: [Cleave 1]. Or: If that attack already has [CLEAVE], +1 to the value of that [CLEAVE] (e.g. [CLEAVE 1] becomes [CLEAVE 2]).

legend.en: Fermented through entirely unstable processes, just a drop of these potent additives can supercharge any Mek-built engine.

when.en: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ORKS MOUNTED/VEHICLE unit is selected to move.

effect.en: Your unit has +2" M.

legend.en: Many Orks think it’s a waste of time blazing away at long range, when it’s more fun to see the effects of potent dakka up close.

when.en: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to shoot.

effect.en: Your unit’s ranged attacks have: [Rapid Fire 1]. Or: If that attack already has [RAPID FIRE], +1 to the value of that [RAPID FIRE] (e.g. [RAPID FIRE 1] becomes [RAPID FIRE 2]).

legend.en: When da Boyz get stuck into the foe, the carnage is wonderful to behold, at least for all their mates.

when.en: Fight phase, when a friendly BOYZ unit that made a charge move this turn is selected to fight.

effect.en: Your unit’s melee attacks have +1 A.

legend.en: With volleys of wagers, threats, insults, dung and the occasional rock, large mobs bolster the spirits of others in the most Orky ways possible.

when.en: Start of the Battle-shock step of your Command phase.

target.en: One friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit of 13+ models.

effect.en: Select one visible friendly ORKS unit within 12" of your unit. That unit’s battle-shock rolls are automatically successful.

legend.en: Orks can put on a surprising turn of speed when the promise of a good face-to-face fight is in the offing.

when.en: Your Movement phase, when a friendly BEAST SNAGGA BOYZ/BOYZ unit is selected to move.

effect.en: Your unit has +2 to advance rolls.

legend.en: With bone-headed arrogance, Nobz will carry on killing before their deaths finally dawn on them.

when.en: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly MEGANOBZ/NOBZ unit.

effect.en: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +1 to that roll if your unit is riled up: On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

legend.en: Nobz load themselves with all manner of weapons in shows of wealth and influence.

when.en: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly MEGANOBZ/NOBZ unit is selected to attack.

effect.en: Your unit’s attacks can: Re-roll hit rolls of 1. If your unit is riled up, re-roll hit rolls.

legend.en: The thick armour and thicker skulls of Nobz make them a daunting prospect to gun down.

when.en: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly MEGANOBZ/NOBZ unit.

effect.en: Ranged attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls. +1CP Or: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 to wound rolls.

legend.en: Short, scrawny and skilled at hiding, there are usually a lot more Gretchin about than meets the eye.

when.en: Any phase, when an enemy unit has attacked.

target.en: One friendly GRETCHIN unit that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this stratagem even though that unit was just destroyed.

effect.en: Add a new GRETCHIN unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in strategic reserves, at its starting strength, with its full wounds remaining.

legend.en: Through natural cowardice or a Runtherd’s threats, Grots’ agile reactions can leave foes flat-footed.

when.en: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged GRETCHIN unit.

effect.en: Your unit can make a normal move of: Up to D6". Or: Up to 6" instead if your unit is an attached unit.

legend.en: Despite their protestations, Gretchin make surprisingly effective bullet shields.

when.en: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit (excluding GRETCHIN units).

target.en: One friendly GRETCHIN unit within 3" of that ORKS INFANTRY unit.

effect.en: When a hit roll for that enemy unit’s ranged attacks that target that ORKS unit results in a hit, if a model in your GRETCHIN unit is on the battlefield, end the attack sequence for that attack and your GRETCHIN unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

legend.en: Extra speshul ammunition is hoarded by those Orks obsessed with dakka, ready for the ideal target when it is splurged in an impressively killy display.

when.en: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit is selected to shoot.

effect.en: Your unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) have +1 to wound rolls.

legend.en: Semi-molten or radioactive slugs; frazzle bullets; shokktastik shells; Orks will try anything they can afford to crack open enemy armour in style.

when.en: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit is selected to shoot.

effect.en: Your unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit within 9" have +1 AP.

legend.en: Squeezing the trigger until their weapon stops firing or falls apart in their hands is a standard tactic for many Orks, and their horrifically wild bursts eventually find their mark.

when.en: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS INFANTRY unit is selected to shoot.

effect.en: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

legend.en: A few Orks, particularly those of a rebelliously disciplined outlook, can resist their destructive urges just long enough to prioritise strategic gains.

when.en: Start/end of your Movement phase.

effect.en: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That objective is secured.

legend.en: When there’s a dirty job needs doing, Orks with strange compulsions get a kick out of causing such trouble sneakily or swiftly.

when.en: Your Movement phase, when a friendly BOYZ/KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move.

effect.en: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.

legend.en: With the gitz they were fighting having scarpered, mobs with a plan exploit the sudden lull to press towards whatever target has next caught their eye.

when.en: End of your opponent’s Movement phase.

target.en: One friendly unengaged BOYZ/KOMMANDOS/STORMBOYZ unit that was engaged at the start of the phase.

effect.en: Your unit can make a normal move of up to 6".

legend.en: Ork transports are not the smoothest of rides. However, the best loot-hunters have honed their drive-by volleys of armour-cracking firepower to the point of deadly accuracy.

when.en: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS TRANSPORT unit is selected to shoot.

effect.en: Your unit’s ranged attacks with weapons selected for the Firing Deck ability have +1 to hit rolls.

legend.en: Wreckin’ some gitz is all well and good, but getting the drop on them and then grabbing an opportunity for some loot is even better.

when.en: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly unengaged BREAKA BOYZ/FLASH GITZ/TANKBUSTAS unit has shot.

effect.en: Your unit can make a normal move of up to 6", and must end that move within range of an objective. Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

legend.en: With a snort of contempt, these Orks decide to show the gitz who just shot at them what real guns are capable of.

when.en: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot.

target.en: One friendly FLASH GITZ/TANKBUSTAS unit hit by those attacks.

effect.en: Your unit shoots using normal shooting, but while doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.

legend.en: Beast Snagga victims often make a break for it before the Orks have tired of fighting. Hooked, impaled or ridden down, few survive such flight.

when.en: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit is selected to make a fall-back move, if that enemy unit is engaged with a friendly BEAST SNAGGA unit.

effect.en: When an enemy unit engaged with your unit is selected to make a fall-back move, that enemy unit must use the desperate escape mode. If that enemy unit is a MONSTER/VEHICLE unit, that enemy unit makes three additional hazard rolls for each BEAST SNAGGA unit it is engaged with, with -1 from those hazard rolls if that enemy unit is battle-shocked.

legend.en: Should attempts to obliterate the Beast Snaggas from afar fail, it is often the foe’s last mistake as the hunters turn their baleful attention on them.

when.en: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot.

target.en: One friendly unengaged BEAST SNAGGA unit that lost a wound as a result of those attacks.

effect.en: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6". If your unit is riled up, it can re-roll that D6.

legend.en: With a keen eye for tracking their prey, Beast Snaggas will circle around to ambush the luckless gitz from another angle.

when.en: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

target.en: One friendly unengaged BEAST SNAGGA unit within 6" of a battlefield edge.

effect.en: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

legend.en: Even horrific damage will not prevent many Ork combat walkers from crunching and stomping their enemies in a final fugue of psychotic aggression.

when.en: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ORKS WALKER unit (excluding TITANIC units).

effect.en: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +3 to the result if your unit has DEFF DREAD: On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

legend.en: Fuelled by the pilot’s obsession or psychosis - and powered up by varied erratic gubbinz - it is little wonder that a Kan’s stomping rampages are constantly reignited.

when.en: Your Movement phase.

effect.en: Your unit is riled up until the start of your next turn.

legend.en: A pilot’s single-mindedness and his walker’s durable form mean few obstacles can impede its relentless stomping advance.

when.en: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly ORKS WALKER unit is selected to move or declares a charge.

effect.en: Your unit has MOBILE.

legend.en: The crews of the Orks’ hulking transports maintain a high level of readiness for when the ladz get bored and rapidly clamber back on board to look for a new fight.

when.en: End of the Fight phase.

target.en: One friendly unengaged ORKS INFANTRY unit that was eligible to fight this phase and is wholly within 6" of a friendly TRANSPORT unit that INFANTRY unit is able to embark within.

effect.en: Your INFANTRY unit embarks within that TRANSPORT unit.

legend.en: Bursting from assault hatches, pounding down boarding ramps or leaping from handholds, this thuggish transport’s fighters are quick to pile out.

when.en: Your Movement phase, when a friendly WAGON unit ends a normal move.

effect.en: Units embarked within your unit can make an assault disembark move.

legend.en: Having several tons of metal covered in blood, rust and spikes bearing down on them can shake the resolve of the most stoic warriors.

when.en: Your Charge phase, when a friendly WAGON unit ends a charge move.

effect.en: Each enemy unit engaged with your unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

legend.en: Besides more dangerous fare, Squig-lobbing buggies fire edible Squigs for a price, guaranteed to enliven any Ork if he can eat it before it eats him.

when.en: Your Movement phase.

effect.en: Select any number of friendly ORKS INFANTRY units within 3" of your unit. Each selected unit heals 3 wounds.

legend.en: Often all an enemy will see of a Kult of Speed is a dust cloud as they speed by, all guns blazing.

when.en: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly SPEED FREEKS unit is selected to shoot.

effect.en: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

legend.en: Speed Freeks are often just blurs of vehicular mayhem that prove difficult to land a blow on.

when.en: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly SPEED FREEKS unit.

effect.en: Ranged attacks that target your unit fail on an unmodified hit roll of 1-3.

legend.en: Some Ork pilots, out of bullets and out of luck, brighten up considerably when they realise their own aircraft is a deadly weapon in its own right.

when.en: Any phase, when a friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT unit is destroyed, before rolling for any Deadly Demise.

effect.en: Your unit does not have the Deadly Demise ability. Select one enemy unit within 12" of your unit and roll eight D6: For each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound. Then remove your unit from the battlefield.

legend.en: Ork Flyboyz will fill the skies with dakka in an attempt to down any enemy they think is muscling in on their aerial turf.

when.en: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT/DEFFKOPTAS unit is selected to shoot.

effect.en: When your unit’s ranged attacks target a FLY unit, those attacks can re-roll hit rolls.

legend.en: Enemy attempts to hunt Deffkoptas down can be stymied by nimble aerial evasion, usually accompanied by a crude hand gesture in the foe’s direction.

when.en: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move.

target.en: One friendly unengaged DEFFKOPTAS unit within 8" of that enemy unit.

effect.en: Your unit can make a normal move of: Up to D6". Or: If your unit is riled up, up to 6".
